recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-31842 unless BRR later decides, through a separate issue, to add specific date extensions or elevate new explicit date elements.
issue_request: FHIR-31842 was a Published FHIR-core BRR change request for MedicinalProductAuthorization/RegulatedAuthorization. Although the issue summary asked that relatedDate.type be code, the persuasive-with-modification resolution was to remove the relatedDate backbone element and rely on explicit attributes plus extensions for other date concepts.
initial_application: Commit bacc2ce1e7d207dd4ad3f82e10de13253efad7cd explicitly applied FHIR#31842 in the RegulatedAuthorization R5 source by commenting out RegulatedAuthorization.relatedDate and its date[x]/type children. Commit c1dda1d5fd1c53b64abb0f0eb8d68392621895cd later deleted that commented-out block entirely.
additional_context: RegulatedAuthorization is active in source/fhir.ini, and MedicinalProductAuthorization maps to RegulatedAuthorization. BRR 2021-09-28 minutes record approval of the resolution to remove the backbone element by an 8-4-4 vote. Current source keeps RegulatedAuthorization.case.date[x] for case/procedure dates, but no longer defines the separate relatedDate backbone.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scope RegulatedAuthorization source already reflects the issue resolution and no source correction is needed.
